entities.name: Deep-sea trench
entities.description: North-south trench running from the Terisian Isles to Sarpadia, inhabited by homarids.

entities.name: Homarids
entities.description: Lobster-like people who bred in the trench and invaded the Vodalian empire.

entities.name: Galina
entities.description: Sarpadian ruler who portaled her court away from homarid waters.

entities.name: Dromar
entities.description: Blue primeval once housed in Dromar's Cavern.

entities.name: Dromar's Cavern
entities.description: Ancient merfolk crypt in the Old Voda Sea part of the trench.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Event after which the trench expanded.

entities.name: Fall of the Sarpadian Empires
entities.description: Period when Galina evacuated her court by portal.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Former Terisian island whose continental plate is shattered.

events.summary: The trench expands from the Old Voda Sea to the Terisian Isles in the wake of the Sylex Blast.
events.quote: The trench expanded from the Old Voda Sea to the Terisian Isles in the wake of the Sylex Blast

events.summary: The homarids rise from the trench and invade the Vodalian empire.
events.quote: the homarids rose from the trench and invaded the Vodalian empire

events.summary: Galina and her court use a portal to take the remnants of her empire from homarid-infested waters.
events.quote: Galina and her court had to resort to a portal to transport the remnants of her empire away

relations.note: Invaded it, forcing merfolk to flee.
relations.quote: the homarids rose from the trench and invaded the Vodalian empire
